text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, the academy is holding a lesson for Umamusume children so they can get some firsthand experience racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower and Sakura Bakushin O have both been assigned to help out with the event.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flower! Let's do our best today! Hey, what's with that worried frown?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: With me around, this lesson is bound to be a great success! The development of these young disciples will progress at Bakushin pace! On that you can rest easy!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: O-okay! I'll do my very best to take on the role of a dependable older sister—one that they can look up to as a role model!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Everybody, please get ready! The kids will be here any minute now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the lesson begins. However…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In short! To Bakushin most effectively, it's essential to move your legs with Bakushin-level vigor…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: Ummm, I don't really get what you're saying…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wha?! My apologies! Perhaps my explanation was a little too Bakushin for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let me put it a different way! Moving your legs with Bakushin-level vigor means putting Bakushin into them as you kick off from the ground during each stride…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: Y-you just said the same thing again…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, this is the ramp where we do incline training…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B
text_block_list.text: She's around the same height as us. Maybe she's only a little older than we are?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C
text_block_list.text: What if I'm actually faster than her? Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask Nishino Flower and Sakura Bakushin O about their groups during break time, but things don't appear to be going well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My Bakushin spirit must have been so overwhelming! They were too awestruck to comprehend what I was saying! Ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The kids in my group didn't really listen to me at all… What should I do?
choice_data_list: You two should go all out in a partner run.
You should teach the kids together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Genius! With both our spirits burning at full Bakushin, the resulting Bakushin inferno of passion is sure to get through to them!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: D-do you think that will work?
choice_data_list: Show them what a big sis is made of.
Show them what a big sis is made of.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …All right, we'll give it a try! Let's do this, Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! That was just like a real race! So that's what Bakushin is!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B
text_block_list.text: You're so fast for your size! I can't run anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm sure all of you will be able to run even faster someday.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C
text_block_list.text: Really?! I wanna run just like you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower and Sakura Bakushin O successfully convey their passion through their race, and the special lesson becomes an unforgettable memory for the children.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Genius! We can ignite the Bakushin in their hearts if we combine our own Bakushin passion together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But… do you think they'll listen to me?
choice_data_list: That's what Bakushin O is here for.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Allow me to take point and draw their attention! They'll be so enraptured that they'll listen to your every word!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A-all right! I'll place my trust in the two of you. Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Therefore! To achieve optimal Bakushin, you must prepare adequately and hit Bakushin-levels of acceleration when the time is just right!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: Uhhh…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, it takes time for you to reach top speed even after you start accelerating.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's why you have to judge the timing of your final spurt so that you're running your fastest in the decisive moment of a race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A
text_block_list.text: Oh… I think I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oho! A perfectly executed Bakushin assist! Nicely done, Flower! You made it even easier to understand!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B
text_block_list.text: Wow, you sounded like a teacher just now… You might be small, but you're just like a big sister!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That she is! Flower is both exemplary and studious!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-you're exaggerating…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By combining their teaching styles, Nishino Flower and Sakura Bakushin O successfully make the special lesson an unforgettable memory for the children.
